evaluation_rules.forecast_method: Rolling hourly forecasts using observations through prediction time t only
evaluation_rules.sarimax_state: Reconstruct from training observations using saved parameters; update through validation and then through each test prediction time without parameter refitting
evaluation_rules.lstm_history: Use the saved lookback window ending at prediction time t
evaluation_rules.feature_order: Require the saved feature names and order
evaluation_rules.availability_assumption: Observations for time t are assumed available at time t; actual publication delays are not simulated

continuous_metrics.primary: Mean RMSE across the 24 horizons, separately for each metric
continuous_metrics.reporting: Report each horizon and a separate +24-hour summary
precipitation_extra_baselines: Mean precipitation from training observations only

rain_probability.event_definition: rain_mm >= 0.1 during the individual target hour
rain_probability.primary: Mean Brier score across the 24 horizons
baselines: Saved training rain frequency for each horizon
rain_probability.calibration: Use existing uncalibrated probabilities; report reliability using fixed bins of width 0.1
rain_probability.threshold_note: The diagnostic threshold is not an approved alert threshold; do not tune thresholds using test results

wind_direction.primary: Mean angular MAE across the 24 horizons
wind_direction.evaluation_mask: Use common rows with non-calm target and baseline wind and a valid predicted direction vector
wind_direction.future_speed_usage: Evaluation masking only, never a prediction input

limitations: Historical weather targets are ERA5 reanalysis estimates
Air-quality targets are CAMS model estimates, not station measurements
October is one test month and cannot establish year-round performance
Overlapping forecast windows are not independent observations
Saved-model verification confirms reproduction, not forecasting accuracy
